mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers a sell-off in equities, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >40% of such events).

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation periods (CPIAUCSL > 6.0% YoY), a federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and aggressive monetary tightening
failure_condition: In periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 6.0% and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it indicates weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained environments (INDPRO growth below 0.5% annually), a further decline in industrial production signals manufacturing sector weakness that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation above 5.0% (CPIAUCSL) and decline in unemployment below 3.5% (UNRATE) signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: overheating economy with labor market tightness
failure_condition: The joint condition of CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and UNRATE < 3.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases (i.e., 20-day returns are positive in >40% of such events).
